products.name: UiPath AI
products.note: RPA + AI platform; document understanding; process mining; enterprise automation governance

profile_text.body:
UiPath is a for-profit, publicly traded company (NYSE: PATH) founded in 2005 and headquartered in New York, NY. Its site describes it as offering the UiPath Platform, a system for business orchestration and automation that brings together AI agents, robotic process automation, and human workers on a single platform. The company positions the platform as purpose-built for enterprises that want to scale AI and automation across existing systems without long development cycles or wholesale replacement of infrastructure.

The company's primary tracked product is UiPath AI, categorized under Automation and Agents, which encompasses RPA combined with AI capabilities, document understanding, process mining, and enterprise automation governance. The site also highlights agentic solutions aimed at critical business workflows and an offering that extends agentic AI into software testing, covering design, automation, execution, and orchestration of testing processes across an enterprise.

UiPath is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001734722 and trades under the ticker PATH. The site's held facts associate the company with 260 legal matters logged under New York jurisdiction, though no specific cases are detailed in the available data.
